mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.title, s.status, s.last_active_at, s.deleted_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, sm.model_label, sm.model_source, skb.kb_id, kb.name AS kb_name FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_models sm ON sm.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN session_knowledge_bases skb ON skb.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.id = skb.kb_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'active'

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.title, s.status, s.last_active_at, s.deleted_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, sm.model_label, sm.model_source, skb.kb_id, kb.name AS kb_name FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_models sm ON sm.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN session_knowledge_bases skb ON skb.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.id = skb.kb_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'archived'
